params.body:
Two documents, no code.

`docs/architecture-audit-2026-10.md` is a companion to the scalability audit. It came out of reviewing Portal mail:34, a price filter that showed a colleague's dealer price, which turned out to be one instance of a pattern: no concept in the codebase has a single home. It measures `main` against the practices document, ranks the findings by risk times how often the pattern recurs, and gives a step-by-step plan that changes one thing at a time. The security findings are stated as classes, not as recipes; they are being fixed in their own pull requests.

`docs/architecture-practices.md` is the reference the audit measures against: allowlists for every filter and sort, one rule in one place, a read model per audience, money as a decimal, views that show rather than decide, characterization tests before a refactor, and architecture tests in CI. For each it says where the code already follows it and where it does not yet.

Also included: the finding that `/singleshowroom/{dealer_id}/{vehicle_id}` renders any vehicle, sold or unpublished, without a login (status open; it belongs with the security work).

The counts come from the code and the schema dump. Production was not readable from where the audit ran, so row counts and real traffic are not in it; each measurement says how to check it.
params.title: Architecture audit and practices, October 2026
